name: Jellyfin-Auto-Collections
description: Automatically create and manage collections in Jellyfin based on configurable rules. Runs on a schedule to keep your collections up to date.

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: Path where config.yaml file will be stored

variables.name: Crontab Schedule
variables.description: Cron expression for scheduling collection updates (default: daily at midnight)

variables.name: Jellyfin Server URL
variables.description: URL of your Jellyfin server (e.g., https://jellyfin.example.com or http://localhost:8096)

variables.name: Jellyfin API Key
variables.description: API key from your Jellyfin server (Dashboard > API Keys)

variables.name: Jellyfin User ID
variables.description: ID of the Jellyfin user account to use
